Third-party files served from our own server (no request to a CDN, so no
visitor IP goes to a third party — see the cookie and privacy pages).
Unmodified copies; to update one, download the new version into a new
version folder and change the template that loads it.

- tabler-icons/3.31.0/ — @tabler/icons-webfont 3.31.0 (dist/tabler-icons.min.css
  + dist/fonts/), MIT. https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
- sortablejs/1.15.2/Sortable.min.js — SortableJS 1.15.2, MIT. https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable
- qrcode/1.5.1/qrcode.js — node-qrcode 1.5.1, build/qrcode.js (browser build,
  global `QRCode`), MIT. https://github.com/soldair/node-qrcode
  (1.5.3, used before, ships no build/ folder: its CDN URL was a 404.)
